explanation: The September 17, 2014 document contains several substantive policy developments that could explain a mid-August structural break: (1) the formal publication of a 'Monetary Policy Normalization Principles and Plans' statement representing a concrete regime-change communication about the path to liftoff, (2) a further tapering of asset purchases (MBS from $10B to $5B, Treasuries from $15B to $10B per month), and (3) explicit forward guidance that the asset purchase program would 'end at its next meeting' — a materially more hawkish signal than prior language. Markets may have begun pricing these outcomes in advance of the September meeting, consistent with a late-August structural break.
